name: PREVIOUSLY IN GTM
tagline: A weekly read for founders, GTM leaders and growth marketers.
page_title: Build Versus Buy Job By Job Draft
title: Stop debating build versus buy. Ask it job by job instead
standfirst: A read on the test that decides whether a new tool earns a seat in your go to market stack, and the habit that quietly wastes the most money in it.
cover_sub: The test that decides whether a new tool earns a seat in your go to market stack.

insight.label: By the numbers
insight.text: Claude named as the most impactful GTM tool by respondents, more than 3x the next closest vendor.
insight.source: Source: Growth Unhinged (Kyle Poyar and Maja Voje), 2026 State of B2B GTM report, 300 respondents, Sept 2026. Self-reported survey data, not audited.

quote.label: Worth pinning above your desk
quote.text: The vendors sell the stopwatch, not the time.
quote.attribution: Marty Berman, GTM Tool Time, "Lead Routing, Reviewed"

framework.title: Four questions before a tool earns a seat
framework.subtitle: Ask them of the job, not the logo.
framework.footer: The headcount question is the one most renewals skip.

items.name: Job
items.question: What exact job is this hired to do?
items.example: One sentence, not a feature list.

items.name: Checkable
items.question: Can an outsider verify the claim?
items.example: Public filings and changelogs beat a vendor's own benchmark.

items.name: Compounding
items.question: Does it improve with your own data?
items.example: Or does it reset at midnight, rented capacity either way.

items.name: Headcount
items.question: Does something already do this job?
items.example: Name the marginal coverage the new tool adds.
